paragraphs: The F-Pace P340 uses the AJ300P — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine from Jaguar Land Rover's Ingenium family. It was offered as a mid-range petrol option within the F-Pace lineup, producing 340PS. The P340 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
